controls-v4-dark.svg: Gated reviews: Two models review every change. A missing vote blocks the PR. Rule-based releases: Fixed rules give GO or HOLD. A model writes notes, never the verdict. Persistent memory: Decisions, pitfalls and dependencies outlive every session. One versioned setup: The rig is pinned, logged and health-checked with one command
